aboutSubheading: Specialist wood flooring across Melbourne's west
aboutText: DK Timber Floors has been crafting beautiful timber floors in Braybrook and Melbourne's western suburbs for years. As Braybrook's dedicated wood floor installation service, we specialise in hardwood installation, sanding, finishing and full floor restoration. Our team works from our Cranwell Street workshop, delivering stunning results for homes and businesses throughout Braybrook, Sunshine, Footscray and surrounds. Every project gets the same meticulous attention to detail and genuine passion for timber flooring.
servicesSubheading: Expert wood floor solutions for Braybrook
servicesText: From brand new hardwood installations to bringing tired old floors back to life, DK Timber Floors offers the complete timber flooring package for Braybrook homes and businesses.

services.title: Hardwood Floor Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of solid hardwood floors throughout your Braybrook home, prepared and finished to the highest standard.

services.title: Floor Sanding & Finishing
services.desc: Professional sanding and finishing that reveals the natural beauty of your timber with lasting protection and shine.

services.title: Timber Floor Restoration
services.desc: We restore aged, damaged or worn timber floors to their former glory with careful repair and refinishing.

services.title: Engineered Timber Flooring
services.desc: Premium engineered wood flooring solutions perfect for Braybrook properties seeking style and durability.

services.title: Staircase & Feature Work
services.desc: Timber cladding, stair treads and feature flooring that adds warmth and character to any interior space.

services.title: Commercial Timber Floors
services.desc: Durable, high-traffic timber flooring installations for Braybrook shops, offices and commercial spaces.
